name: Rot Hide Origins
summary: In Silverpine Forest, the Rot Hides carry a magic Renferrel cannot explain by alchemy alone. He sends a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity, where arcane knowledge may reveal its origin.

sections.title: A Concoction of Death and Fel
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel has reduced fluid from the Rot Hides of Silverpine Forest to its basic elements. His first tests show the ichor bears both necromancy and warlock magic. Alchemy cannot explain the sorcery behind it, so he prepares a sample for an expert in the Undercity.

sections.title: Audience with the Mage
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard, a Forsaken mage in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, studies the sample. He is not part of the Royal Apothecary Society, but knows arcane and dark arts. The vial holds old, potent enchantments he has not seen in years. Bethor begins a divination to learn who wove the magic.

faq.q: Who sends the player on this quest?
aliases: where do i get rot hide origins
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel of the Royal Apothecary Society sends you from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He examined ichor taken from nearby Rot Hides.

faq.q: Why does Renferrel send the sample to Bethor Iceshard?
faq.answer: Renferrel finds necromantic and warlock magic in the Rot Hide ichor. Since alchemy cannot explain the enchantments, he sends the sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity for arcane study.
Bethor Iceshard lives in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, among arcane researchers and trainers.
Rot Hides are undead gnolls prowling Silverpine Forest. Their rotting condition comes from foul magical experiments.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver the sample to Bethor?
faq.answer: Bethor recognizes old, potent magic in the fluid, spells he has not encountered in a very long time. He begins a divination to trace its source.

aliases: next quest after rot hide origins
follow up to rot hide origins
faq.answer: After Bethor's divination, he sends you to investigate the renegade mage corrupting the gnolls in Thule Ravenclaw.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society and the arcane masters of the Undercity work together, joining science and sorcery to protect Lordaeron.
As a Mage, you know arcane divination and learned spellcraft can uncover dark mysteries beyond ordinary alchemy.
As a Warlock, you recognize fel and warlock magic mingled with necromancy in the Rot Hide ichor. Such forbidden spellcraft is at work in the Silverpine wilderness.
